primary_source.read_depth: Complete main text and captions; complete supplement text/captions/methods. Main images 1, 5, 6 and supplementary images S5, S6 inspected. Other main images and downloaded spreadsheet not independently analyzed.

earlier_version.read_depth: Selected drug Results, Discussion and Methods; not every figure or supplement.
earlier_version.result: No survival improvement reported in preprint; published version reports benefit under a different regimen. Regimen difference alone does not establish why the outcome changed.
